create_AgentStates: create an AgentStates instance to track decoding progress for source and target sequences
reset_AgentStates: reset AgentStates to clear source, target, and configuration state
update_source_AgentStates: update AgentStates source from a TextSegment or SpeechSegment input
update_target_AgentStates: update AgentStates target from a TextSegment or SpeechSegment output
